dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as a single, thin, white horizontal band of high grayscale contrast across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness; prominent white-to-pale-gray edges along the folded primaries and secondaries create a tiered linear pattern.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, roughly rectangular white patch located centrally on the posterior neck, contrasting with the black crown and greenish mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, linear demarcation between the black nape/neck and the greenish-yellow mantle, punctuated by the white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white sub-ocular/cheek patch completely enclosed by black plumage of the head and throat.
